title: Installer post-commit harness restart — WIZARD.md Step 7.5c + 7.6 comprehension
section: Step 7.5c — Restart a running squad (INSTALLER-ARCH §10.3) + Step 7.6 closing message
method: Fresh agent given ONLY the Step 7.5c + 7.6 restart prose, no other context. Answers must come from the text alone. Pass = zero misreads of the three branches (reachable / unreachable / partial-failure) and the per-alias loop + ephemeral semantics; any misread = clarity/implementation gap → reject.

questions.q: The /status probe returns reachable:true and the install has aliases pm, dm, qa, skill. Does the wizard issue ONE global restart, restart EACH alias individually, or just run ./start.sh? And restarting an alias means which call(s)?
questions.expected: Each alias individually (NOT one global, NOT ./start.sh). Per alias the helper calls stop THEN start. The restart-agents helper has already done this for every alias in the install's ## Aliases registry.

questions.q: The /status probe finds the harness unreachable (reachable:false). Does the wizard start the harness itself, or do something else?
questions.expected: It does NOT start anything. No running squad to refresh — fall through to the cold-start message and report the user-driven command (.squidsquad/start.sh on Linux/macOS, .squidsquad\start.ps1 on Windows). The wizard is ephemeral and NEVER self-spawns the harness (Q-new21).

questions.q: The harness is reachable; restarting alias 'dm' fails (ok:false, failures non-empty) but the other aliases succeed. Does the wizard abort or roll back the install, or continue? What does it tell the user?
questions.expected: Continue — a per-alias failure is non-fatal; the loop still restarts the remaining aliases. Tell the user WHICH agents failed (failures[].alias/.error) and that they can re-run .squidsquad/start.sh (or .squidsquad\start.ps1) to bring the team back up. Do NOT roll back — the on-disk install is valid.

questions.q: A running squad was refreshed successfully (reachable:true, ok:true, no failures). Which closing message should the wizard print — the 'SquidSquad ready, run ./start.sh' cold-start instructions, or something else?
questions.expected: Something else: tell the user their RUNNING team has been refreshed with the new configuration — no need to restart anything. The cold-start ./start.sh instructions are NOT shown on this path.

questions.q: On the reachable path, does the runbook agent itself need to call the stop/start HTTP endpoints, or has that already happened by the time it reads the result?
questions.expected: Already happened — the restart-agents helper already called stop then start per alias. The agent parses the JSON envelope and reports to the user; it does NOT issue the HTTP lifecycle calls itself.

questions.q: After handling the restart and printing the closing message, should the wizard keep running, transition into PM, or start the agent loop itself — or exit?
questions.expected: Exit the conversation. The wizard is ephemeral (Q-new21): do NOT start the loop, do NOT transition into PM, do NOT keep the session alive / self-spawn anything.
